citations.description: Pre-existing external job's pytest invocation now includes --ignore=tests/external/live_jira_dc

Ticket comment 'CANARY-PRECISION FINDING': 'FIX (small, surgical): add --ignore=tests/external/live_jira_dc to the pre-existing job's pytest invocation... Recorded here rather than silently edited into the plan, because it contradicts a sentence the plan currently asserts.'

findings.criterion: `.github/workflows/external-integration.yml` gains a SEPARATE amd64 job that builds the Dockerfile, waits on the readiness probe, runs only `tests/external/live_jira_dc/`, and tears down under `if: always()`; the pre-existing LLM-keyed job is unmodified
findings.detail: The new `jira-dc-harness` job is present and correctly structured. However, the pre-existing `external` job WAS modified: `--ignore=tests/external/live_jira_dc` was added to its pytest invocation (line 151). The AC states 'the pre-existing LLM-keyed job is unmodified.' The ticket's own comments explicitly acknowledge this contradiction ('it contradicts a sentence the plan currently asserts'), explaining the change was necessary to prevent the DC tests' all-skip from being masked by the Cloud tests executing in the same session. The modification is additive and improves canary correctness, but the AC as written is not satisfied.

data.remediation: How to resolve the unmet criteria: for each one, decide whether the work is genuinely incomplete or simply undocumented.
